mapper.sql: lp.id, lp.title, lp.category_id, lp.subcategory_id, lp.description, lp.cover_image, lp.difficulty, lp.duration_weeks, lp.is_vip_only, lp.status, lp.sort_order, lp.created_by, lp.created_at, lp.updated_at, lc.name as category_name, lc.description as category_description, lc.icon as category_icon, lc.sort_order as category_sort_order, lc.status as category_status, lsc.name as subcategory_name, lsc.description as subcategory_description, lsc.icon as subcategory_icon, lsc.sort_order as subcategory_sort_order
FROM learning_paths lp LEFT JOIN learning_categories lc ON lp.category_id = lc.id LEFT JOIN learning_subcategories lsc ON lp.subcategory_id = lsc.id
mapper.select:
SELECT
WHERE lp.status = 'PUBLISHED' ORDER BY lp.sort_order ASC, lp.created_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO learning_paths (title, category_id, subcategory_id, description, cover_image, difficulty, duration_weeks, is_vip_only, status, sort_order, created_by) VALUES (#{title}, #{categoryId}, #{subcategoryId}, #{description}, #{coverImage}, #{difficulty}, #{durationWeeks}, #{isVipOnly}, #{status}, #{sortOrder}, #{createdBy})
mapper.update: UPDATE learning_paths SET title = #{title}, category_id = #{categoryId}, subcategory_id = #{subcategoryId}, description = #{description}, cover_image = #{coverImage}, difficulty = #{difficulty}, duration_weeks = #{durationWeeks}, is_vip_only = #{isVipOnly}, status = #{status}, sort_order = #{sortOrder} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select:
SELECT
WHERE lp.category_id = #{categoryId} AND lp.status = 'PUBLISHED' ORDER BY lp.sort_order ASC

SELECT
WHERE lp.subcategory_id = #{subcategoryId} AND lp.status = 'PUBLISHED' ORDER BY lp.sort_order ASC

SELECT
WHERE lp.status = #{status} ORDER BY lp.sort_order ASC

SELECT
WHERE lp.created_by = #{createdBy} ORDER BY lp.created_at DESC

SELECT
WHERE lp.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND (lp.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR lp.description LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')) ORDER BY lp.sort_order ASC, lp.created_at DESC

SELECT , COALESCE(SUM(lu.view_count), 0) as total_view_count
LEFT JOIN path_stages ps ON lp.id = ps.path_id LEFT JOIN learning_units lu ON ps.id = lu.stage_id WHERE lp.status = 'PUBLISHED' GROUP BY lp.id, lp.title, lp.category_id, lp.subcategory_id, lp.description, lp.cover_image, lp.difficulty, lp.duration_weeks, lp.is_vip_only, lp.status, lp.sort_order, lp.created_by, lp.created_at, lp.updated_at, lc.name, lc.description, lc.icon, lc.sort_order, lc.status, lsc.name, lsc.description, lsc.icon, lsc.sort_order ORDER BY total_view_count DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT lp.id, lp.title, lp.difficulty, lp.is_vip_only, lp.status, lp.created_at, lc.name as category_name, lsc.name as subcategory_name FROM learning_paths lp LEFT JOIN learning_categories lc ON lp.category_id = lc.id LEFT JOIN learning_subcategories lsc ON lp.subcategory_id = lsc.id ORDER BY lp.created_at DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM learning_paths WHERE status = 'PUBLISHED'
